crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Transverse series of discrete, high-contrast pale rectangular spots across the posterior neck region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct linear transition where the spotted nape pattern meets the solid-colored dorsal mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Heavy horizontal dark barring alternating with lighter gray bands across the visible tail rectrices.
